mapper.select: SELECT comment_num AS commentNum, id, num, data_source, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAT, is_deleted AS isDeleted, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM found_comment WHERE num = #{num} AND data_source = #{dataSource} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY comment_num ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO found_comment ( id, num, data_source, content ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{num}, #{dataSource}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT u.email FROM user u INNER JOIN found f ON u.id = f.id WHERE f.atc_id = #{atcId};

SELECT comment_num AS commentNum, id, num, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, is_deleted AS isDeleted, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM found_comment WHERE comment_num = #{commentNum} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE found_comment SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_num = #{commentNum} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE found_comment SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE comment_num = #{commentNum}
